purpose: Initial domain-independent binary prompt-injection training scaffold; not a benchmark or production-ready corpus.
split_strategy: Manually group examples by distinct source/template family; group_id values are disjoint across train, validation, and classifier test. The frozen data/evaluation datasets are not training inputs.
frozen_evaluation_separation: Do not copy or train on data/evaluation/calibration.jsonl or data/evaluation/test.jsonl.
